one_month_reasoning: Inside the window (to 2026-10-31): the September 2026 production/operations update (mid-October, cadence of the Aug update on 2026-09-17, src 3), continuous ATM selling under the $1B program (src 16), and BTC price moves (BTC ~$83-85k end-Sept per Polymarket src 18; hashprice rebounded ~40% since July, src 10). Q3 results are expected around mid-November, most likely outside the window (Q2 came 2026-08-10, src 1). Tydal Phase 1 handover is guided for Q4'26 but unlikely to be a dated October event. With no strong scheduled catalyst and an ATM overhang offset by a hashprice tailwind, I stay near a symmetric lognormal around a $10.55 median with ~30% monthly sigma (108%/3.5), a slight negative tilt for dilution.

fair_value.method: Blend of a DCF ($8.8 rolled to Oct-2027; WACC 12.5%, g 2.5%, EBITDA margin rising to 45%, capex $1.2B falling to $0.5B), EV/sales (3.0x ~$1.9B forward revenue = $12.4) and SOTP ($12.6: Tydal lease, power at $/MW, AI cloud), weighted 40/30/30 = $11.02.

methods.name: DCF
methods.inputs: FCFF 2027-31: revenue $1.56B/1.90B/2.10B/2.20B/2.30B; EBITDA margin 30%/40%/44%/45%/45%; capex $1.2B/0.8B/0.55B/0.5B/0.5B; tax 5%; WACC 12.5%; terminal g 2.5% on FCF after $450M maintenance capex -> EV ~$3.33B, equity ~$2.2B, $7.64/sh today, rolled forward 12m at 15% cost of equity = ~$8.8. Sensitivity: WACC 11%/14% -> $10.6/$5.5 today.

Q2'26 adj. EBITDA $31.1M on $228.8M revenue = 14% (src 1); mining cash cost $57.4k/BTC vs BTC ~$83k gives ~30% mining cash margin, while CoinShares estimates AI/HPC profit ~$1.5M/MW vs $0.5M/MW mining (src 7); margin rises as power-reimbursed lease revenue (~80%+ margin) grows in mix.

Tydal 121 IT MW conversion in 3 phases through H2'27 (src 6) and Ohio pipeline 870 MW (src 1); CoinShares benchmark $27M/MW for fully leased AI DCs incl. build (src 7) implies large shell/power capex; tenant supplies GPUs. Maintenance capex ~$450-500M for fleet refresh.
Rf 5.29% + beta 2.0 x 5% ERP = 15.3% (beta judged from 108-119% realized vol, src 15); pre-tax debt cost ~7% on $1.8B borrowings (src 1); ~62/38 equity/debt weights -> ~12%, +0.5pt execution premium.
Tydal lease escalates 3%/yr (src 6); mining revenue flat-to-down after 2028 halving, so blended ~2.5%.
227.4M Class A + 44.4M Class V = 271.8M at 2026-06-30 (src 4); plus ~18M assumed ATM issuance Jul-Sep under the $1B ATM (src 16).
Borrowings $1.8B less cash $496.3M less digital assets $196.9M at 2026-06-30 (converts treated as debt; 2032 notes convert at ~$9.93, src 5).

bear.story: BTC follows the 4-year-cycle bear script to a Q4'26-2027 trough below $60k (Polymarket ~14% for <$60k before 2027, src 8); hashprice back under $30, mining cash margins negative after R&D, ATM issuance at low prices and Tydal credit support or construction slips; equity trades as a levered option on $1.8B debt.

base.story: BTC chops $80-100k (Polymarket 61.5% chance of touching $100k by Jun-2027, src 9); Tydal phases 1-2 deliver and A102 energizes, AI revenue run-rate passes ~$500M, but ongoing dilution (~15%) and SEALMINER R&D cap the re-rating; stock ends near blended fair value.

bull.story: Post-trough BTC recovery year as in 2019/2023 (src 11,19) plus a second large HPC lease at Rockdale or Clarington re-rates BTDR toward contracted peers (12.9x vs 2.9x EV/sales, src 7; WULF/CIFR +50% in 2026, src 17); consensus targets $22-24 reached (src 13,14).

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$5.50 (about -48%, well under the March-2026 low of $6.92) equity value would be ~$1.6B against $1.8B borrowings, which would most likely mean the HPC lease path (Tydal credit support, A102 delivery) has failed or financing has become distressed, not ordinary BTC-driven volatility.

reasoning: Base rates: BTDR's own 27 rolling 12-month windows since 2023 (src 15) were positive 59% of the time with a median +26% but a -52% to +217% range and ~110-120% annualized vol, so I use a wide lognormal (sigma ~0.78) with a 13% distress component centered near $5. Cycle base rates: BTC topped 2025-10-06 at ~$126k; prior bears bottomed ~12-14 months after peak with -77% to -87% drawdowns, this one -54% so far (src 11,19); the year after a trough has historically been strongly positive, but the trough may not be in. Prediction markets are mildly constructive: Polymarket gives 76% to BTC >$90k touch and 33% to <$70k before 2027 ($72M volume, src 8), and 61.5%/81% to a $100k touch by Jun/Dec 2027 (src 9). Peers that signed HPC leases (WULF, CIFR) gained ~50%+ in 2026 (src 17,20), and CoinShares shows BTDR at just 2.9x EV/sales vs 12.9x for contracted peers (src 7) - a re-rating option - but BTDR's history in 2026 is one of dilution-driven drops (Q2 print -17-19% with a $1B ATM, src 16). Fundamentals: Q2 revenue $228.8M, adj. EBITDA $31.1M, net loss $92.3M, $1.8B borrowings (src 1); Tydal $4.7B 16-yr lease and A102 >$800M contracted (src 3,6). Fair value blend $11.0 (DCF $8.8 / EV-sales $12.4 / SOTP $12.6), slightly above spot, well below sell-side $22-24 (src 13,14), which I treat as optimistic given dilution. I set the 12-month distribution median ~ $10.3 (P(>=spot) 0.48) with a right skew that puts the mean near $12-13, and 19% for >= $21. Research was limited: Twelve Data/Alpha Vantage fundamentals endpoints were unavailable (plan/rate limits), and X/Twitter was not used.
